root_cause.text: The `gve_tx_clean_pending_packets()` function fails to verify QPL mode before executing buffer cleanup, causing it to incorrectly apply RDA-specific DMA unmap logic to QPL buffers where the storage layout overlaps with buffer IDs and the iteration count exceeds the DMA array bounds.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that in DQ-QPL mode the function "incorrectly uses the RDA buffer cleanup path," noting that the "dma array shares storage with tx_qpl_buf_ids" and "num_bufs... can significantly exceed the size of the dma array," while the patch diff introduces a conditional check `if (tx->dqo.qpl)` to delegate cleanup to `gve_free_tx_qpl_bufs()` instead of the generic unmap loop.
